text:
Tara: Quick heads-up — new hire Naomi Park (start Mon 04/14) lands Sun 20:10. Background check still shows 'Pending — identity docs requested' in Checkr. I-9 was booked Mon 10:00 at Kiosk A but security only staffed until 18:30 on weekdays, so badge pickup after 6pm won't work. Options? :thinking_face:
Emily: Can we move the I-9 earlier to 08:00 on Monday? Or do mobile I-9 via notary on Sunday evening if candidate can meet. Notary costs extra though.
Raj: Checkr often clears within 24h if passport is fine. Do we know if passport scan uploaded? If yes, we can push to 08:15. I've placed a temporary badge hold in the system but security needs confirmation.
Security-Team: Badge hold request received for Naomi Park. We'll respond in ~2 hours with staffing options.
Lena-Courier: I can accept a courier pickup at the airport — terminal desk open until ~23:00 in case Naomi can drop docs. Need candidate consent in writing.
Tara: Naomi said she's okay to meet the courier at terminal 3 baggage claim. I'll DM her now to confirm consent and preferred time.
Emily: If courier picks up Sunday, Ops can deliver docs to Kiosk A Monday morning and we can verify before security shift ends. Need someone from Ops to be present for verification.
Raj: I can do the I-9 verification at 08:15 Monday. I'll take the 08:00 slot and be at the lobby. @Security-Team can you arrange a temp pass to get her to the verification point?
Security-Team: @Raj confirmed. Reception will issue a temporary visitor pass for Naomi at 08:00; full badge issuance will happen after BG clears.
Tara: People-ops-bot: Candidate Naomi Park submitted the DocuSign I-9 consent form.
People-ops-bot: Reminder — please upload passport scans to the Checkr portal: https://checkr.example/naomi (candidate ID 78901).
Emily: Quick Monday AM checklist:
```
- 08:00 Naomi arrives at lobby, temp pass from reception
- 08:15 I-9 verification (Raj)
- 08:30 Laptop pickup (IT)
- 09:00 Manager 1:1 and orientation kickoff
- Badge issued after BG cleared (Security finalises)
```
Mike: IT update — Naomi's laptop shipping delayed to Monday AM. I'll bring it to reception in a locked staging box labeled "NAOMI PARK — DO NOT OPEN" and hand to Raj after verification.
Emily: Naomi requested hybrid desk in SF-2; reserving a hotdesk for week 1 and emailing calendar invite.
Raj: I'll confirm kiosk booking change. If Checkr gets flagged, fallback = remote-first day and buddy onboarding. @Tara, please prepare HR escalation template in case of adverse BG.
Tara: Added escalation doc: https://redwoodhr.docs/onboard/escalation-template — ping me and @People-ops if anything escalates.
Naomi: (candidate) Hi everyone — confirmed. I can meet the courier at Terminal 3 baggage claim at 21:15. Thanks so much for being flexible! :slightly_smiling_face:
Emily: Perfect — I'll send Naomi the Day-1 itinerary and phone numbers for Raj and the courier.
People-ops-bot: Thread updated — badge hold placed; kiosk reschedule pending. :white_check_mark:
